public_labels: smart contract vulnerability (SlowMist paraphrase: unbacked minting incident)
mechanism.victim_contract_type: TON DeFi lending protocol (per DefiLlama target type 'DeFi Protocol'); specific pool/vault/minter NOT publicly identified
mechanism.notes: No source has published a root-cause, function, opcode, or exploit trace. Any specific mechanism would be speculation.

independent_security_firm_coverage.detail: No incident-specific post found from PeckShield/PeckShieldAlert, BlockSec, Ancilia, CertiK, Cyvers, or Beosin. SlowMist Hacked has an entry but cites DefiLlama only; SlowMist's @SlowMist_Team feed around 2026-10-14..10-21 covers other incidents (UNCX, Pirate Chain, Qubic, AlpsCon, Slice) but not Affluent.

mainstream_press_coverage.detail: No article found on CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, CryptoSlate, or Rekt covering the Affluent incident. No Rekt.news entry (not on leaderboard; /affluent-rekt/ returns HTTP 500).

date_discrepancy.note: DefiLlama and SlowMist both record 2026-10-16. No public source supports Oct 14/15.

confidence_rationale: Only two public records exist (DefiLlama primary; SlowMist derived from it). DefiLlama's own source field is empty, no security firm or press independently verified, no on-chain identifiers are published, and the protocol's channels have been silent since before the incident. The existence and headline (date/amount/chain) are moderately well-attested; everything about attacker, contract, transaction, and mechanism is unconfirmed.
